summary: A pairing begun on member A cannot be finished on member B; start it again on B.

schema.detail: No claim schema or storage changes.

compatibility.detail: Person pairing completion now refuses replicated challenges on a non-origin member with the additive, non-retryable pairing-origin-required error code. Pairing request and response shapes are unchanged. Before begin, the pair command refuses --gateway URLs matching a different configured member, then anonymously probes the gateway's health node with a three-second reachability bound and refuses a different member. Unreachable gateways or responses without a node warn that completion must reach the local beginning member.

manual.detail: Upgrade every member accepting pairing completion to this version or later: an older member has no origin check and can still complete a replicated challenge begun on an upgraded member. Only then does the origin guarantee hold. If completion is refused, restart pairing on the member that began it and complete through that member's gateway.

recovery.detail: Start the pairing again on the beginning member. A refusal leaves the original challenge unconsumed and issues no credential or device grant.
